description: Αποφάσεις έγκρισης κυκλοφοριακών ρυθμίσεων ΟΤΑ Α΄ Βαθμού is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Διεύθυνση Τεχνικού Ελέγχου. Entsandte Beschlüsse zur Genehmigung der Verkehrsregelung der Gemeinden A ΄ von Vthos (Verkehrsregelung gemäß Artikel 48 Absatz 9 des Gesetzes 4313/2014). Coverage: Διεύθυνση Τεχνικού Ελέγχου. The portal shows the English title as "Deċiżjonijiet li japprovaw l-arranġamenti tat-traffiku OTA A ΄ Grade" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Διεύθυνση Τεχνικού Ελέγχου. Its keywords include Από μετάπτωση, Κυκλοφοριακέσ ρυθμίσεισ, Τεχνικός έλεγχος, repository.data.gov.gr. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XML, JSON. The listing shows 2026-04-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
